title: Render the whole site after a backend deploy
description: When the backend deploy finishes (new renderer or theme in the content-actions Lambda), run a full render (today: project --all) inside AWS, then the drift check (--reconcile --dry-run, and --reconcile for orphans). Options: a post-deploy step in the build spec, or the content Lambda rendering everything when its bundled site code hash changes. Done: a theme-only PR goes live on anth.us with no manual step, the drift check is clean, and the run's result is visible in the build log.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Papyrus PR #204 merged (7cfffa1, released in 1.0.0-next.54): reprojectOnDeploy now invokes content-actions synchronously with a deploy-render task (project_all, then reconcile dry-run); a failed render fails the stack update and the Amplify build; drift is returned, logged, emitted as Papyrus/Projection DeployRenderDrift and alarmed; nothing is deleted. Proven on throwaway stack papyrus-mid-test (papyrus-production, deleted afterwards): clean run, drift run (orphan reported, kept, alarm went ALARM), render failure (CFN CREATE_FAILED with the Lambda error). Anth.us PR AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus#48 sets reprojectOnDeploy true (open, not merged). Production re-render not run.

right_now_summary: The team is choosing how to trigger a full site render after each backend deploy.
